semiconductor_relevance: High — Exicon specializes in Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) and Test Services for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Exicon Co., Ltd. is a leader in the Automatic Test Equipment (ATE) sector, providing high-speed memory testers and a range of test services. With over ten years of expertise, the company offers solutions for memory, storage, and system-on-chip testing, ensuring high-quality service and competitive pricing.
